name: Spark

temperament: Quick, clever and restless; it darts ahead, always a step before the thunder
scenePlacement: crouched at her feet with its tails raised, static arcing between them
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
